highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 combines Skia m155 with HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and Linux font-matching corrections.
highlights_body: The release improves failed-flush cache cleanup and updates HarfBuzz shaping behavior. Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction are disabled.

breaking.title: Decode RAW and DNG images outside SkiaSharp
breaking.body: The bundled DNG SDK and PIEX decoding routes are disabled, including extraction of embedded JPEG previews from RAW files. Use an external decoder and pass pixels or an extracted JPEG to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but no replacement RAW backend is included.

breaking.title: Review cross-direction mark positioning
breaking.body: HarfBuzz 14.4.0 intentionally changes cross-direction mark positioning for DirectWrite and Core Text compatibility. Review text layouts and rendering baselines that depend on the previous mark positions when upgrading.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 155 while preserving the managed API and the explicit bounds behavior of rotation-scale text runs.

Updates the shaping engine with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping and subsetting performance work. HarfBuzzSharp packages start a new 14.4.0 revision line.
Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enum values for the updated native source. The raw fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced.

Checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted fontconfig candidate, rather than accepting a lower-ranked metric-compatible substitute and preventing the caller from trying its next requested family.
Drops uniquely held Ganesh thread-safe-cache entries after a failed flush so later draws cannot reuse those entries' uninitialized textures.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Updated HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes and new OpenType tag enums. Disabled built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and Linux fontconfig first-candidate matching.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0, including cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation and malformed-font fixes. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping the raw fetch functions internal.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: Preview 1 opens the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and removes built-in RAW/DNG decoding.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: Embedded RAW-preview extraction is also disabled; decode those formats externally. HarfBuzzSharp adds OpenType tag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal. Review text-layout baselines for the intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: The release candidate corrects Ganesh cache cleanup and Linux fontconfig matching.
v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.body: Failed flushes discard uniquely held cache entries, and sorted font matching checks only the first valid candidate.

v4.155.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 promotes the release candidate to stable without additional collected product changes.
